$comment: The subjects of the ecosystem: which folder holds each one's knowledge, and which projects belong to it. Every project in repos.json is in exactly one subject (tools/check-docs.mjs checks it). Root issues carry a subject:<id> label (docs/agents/issue-tracker.md). Human-readable map: GLOSSARY-MAP.md. State is never written here: run node tools/status.mjs.

process.title: Process and ecosystem
process.summary: How the ecosystem is developed: sessions, the merge gate, CI and releases, health reviews, the tools, the sandbox dissolution.

platform.title: Fragment platform
platform.summary: The headless kernel, core fragments, the React shell and the hosts that serve fragments (browser, CellB Node, Workers).

ai-harness.title: AI harness
ai-harness.summary: Agent sessions, definitions, access and code execution (light containers, containers) on CellB, CellD and Workers.

runtimes.title: Durable Objects runtimes
runtimes.summary: CellB (isomorphic Durable Objects runtime, in Node and in a browser tab), CellD, and running other engines on them.

vcs.title: Version control
vcs.summary: webrun-vcs: a git-compatible VCS in TypeScript on web APIs only, with parity against native git.

p2p.title: P2P and capabilities
p2p.summary: Byte channels and RPC (webrun-wire), the HTTPeers mesh, Biscuit capabilities, and the webrun-devtools extension.

sites.title: Sites and notebooks
sites.summary: Observable notebooks built to static sites, the site kit, and every statewalker project site.

product.title: Product
product.summary: SandClaw, the branded applications built on the platform, and the first paid offer.

data.title: Data and storage
data.summary: FilesApi, database drivers, indexers and sync: the storage layer the other subjects build on.
